records.key: A crop has no matching merged field with its complete identity; restore that field before conversion.
records.source: A crop has no matching merged field with its complete identity; restore that field before conversion.
records.translation: Myndskurður á sér ekkert samsvarandi sameinað sjónsvið í merged með fullu auðkenni sínu; endurheimtu það sjónsvið fyrir umbreytingu.

records.key: A crop has no single positive object label; multi-object and missing-label PNGs must remain legacy-only.
records.source: A crop has no single positive object label; multi-object and missing-label PNGs must remain legacy-only.
records.translation: Myndskurður hefur ekki eitt jákvætt hlutarmerki; PNG-myndir með mörgum hlutum eða án merkis verða að vera áfram eingöngu á eldra sniði.

records.key: A crop label is absent from its effective mask: {label}
records.source: A crop label is absent from its effective mask: {label}
records.translation: Merki myndskurðar vantar í grímuna sem er í raun notuð: {label}

records.key: A crop needs its native merged intensities and effective object mask; retain this PNG as legacy-only.
records.source: A crop needs its native merged intensities and effective object mask; retain this PNG as legacy-only.
records.translation: Myndskurður þarf upprunaleg sameinuð styrkgildi úr merged og hlutagrímuna sem er í raun notuð; haltu þessari PNG-mynd eingöngu á eldra sniði.

records.key: A crop pool has conflicting native dtypes or channel maps; split the source into compatible projects.
records.source: A crop pool has conflicting native dtypes or channel maps; split the source into compatible projects.
records.translation: Safn myndskurða hefur ósamrýmanlegar upprunalegar gagnagerðir eða rásavarpanir; skiptu upprunanum í samrýmanleg verkefni.

records.key: A crop row has no PNG path; restore its original source record.
records.source: A crop row has no PNG path; restore its original source record.
records.translation: Færslu myndskurðar vantar PNG-slóð; endurheimtu upphaflega upprunafærslu hennar.

records.key: A mask role conflicts with a reserved legacy-plane name: {role}
records.source: A mask role conflicts with a reserved legacy-plane name: {role}
records.translation: Hlutverk grímu stangast á við frátekið heiti eldra myndplans: {role}

records.key: A recorded crop PNG is missing from the source inventory: {path}
records.source: A recorded crop PNG is missing from the source inventory: {path}
records.translation: Skráða PNG-mynd af myndskurði vantar í upprunaskrána: {path}

records.key: All label images in a field must have the same shape: {field}
records.source: All label images in a field must have the same shape: {field}
records.translation: Allar merkjamyndir í sjónsviði verða að hafa sömu lögun: {field}

records.key: An existing crop object_id must be a nonempty unique string; preserve and repair its source identity first.
records.source: An existing crop object_id must be a nonempty unique string; preserve and repair its source identity first.
records.translation: Fyrirliggjandi object_id myndskurðar verður að vera ótómur einkvæmur textastrengur; varðveittu og lagfærðu fyrst upprunaauðkenni hans.

records.key: Channel metadata verification failed: {field}
records.source: Channel metadata verification failed: {field}
records.translation: Sannprófun lýsigagna rása mistókst: {field}

records.key: Choose a nonempty subset of merged, masks and crops.
records.source: Choose a nonempty subset of merged, masks and crops.
records.translation: Veldu ótómt hlutmengi úr merged, masks og crops.

records.key: Choose an existing source and a separate, nonoverlapping destination.
records.source: Choose an existing source and a separate, nonoverlapping destination.
records.translation: Veldu fyrirliggjandi uppruna og aðskilinn áfangastað sem skarast ekki við hann.

records.key: Close database writers and checkpoint the project before conversion: {path}
records.source: Close database writers and checkpoint the project before conversion: {path}
records.translation: Lokaðu ferlum sem skrifa í gagnagrunninn og gerðu gátpunkt verkefnisins fyrir umbreytingu: {path}

records.key: Committed crop attributes differ from the conversion plan; retain originals.
records.source: Committed crop attributes differ from the conversion plan; retain originals.
records.translation: Eigindir staðfestra myndskurða eru frábrugðnar umbreytingaráætluninni; varðveittu frumritin.

records.key: Committed crop files changed; keep originals and inspect the destination.
records.source: Committed crop files changed; keep originals and inspect the destination.
records.translation: Skrár staðfestra myndskurða hafa breyst; varðveittu frumritin og skoðaðu áfangastaðinn.

records.key: Committed crop locators differ from the conversion plan; retain originals.
records.source: Committed crop locators differ from the conversion plan; retain originals.
records.translation: Staðsetningarvísar staðfestra myndskurða eru frábrugðnir umbreytingaráætluninni; varðveittu frumritin.

records.key: Committed crop membership differs from the conversion plan; retain originals.
records.source: Committed crop membership differs from the conversion plan; retain originals.
records.translation: Samsetning safns staðfestra myndskurða er frábrugðin umbreytingaráætluninni; varðveittu frumritin.

records.key: Committed crop metadata changed; keep originals and inspect the destination.
records.source: Committed crop metadata changed; keep originals and inspect the destination.
records.translation: Lýsigögn staðfestra myndskurða hafa breyst; varðveittu frumritin og skoðaðu áfangastaðinn.

records.key: Committed crop rows differ from the conversion plan; retain originals.
records.source: Committed crop rows differ from the conversion plan; retain originals.
records.translation: Færslur staðfestra myndskurða eru frábrugðnar umbreytingaráætluninni; varðveittu frumritin.

records.key: Conversion is blocked: {problems}
records.source: Conversion is blocked: {problems}
records.translation: Umbreyting er stöðvuð: {problems}

records.key: Conversion paths must not contain traversal or symlinks: {path}
records.source: Conversion paths must not contain traversal or symlinks: {path}
records.translation: Umbreytingarslóðir mega ekki innihalda slóðaflakk eða tákntengla: {path}

records.key: Conversion requires ordinary local files: {path}
records.source: Conversion requires ordinary local files: {path}
records.translation: Umbreyting krefst venjulegra staðbundinna skráa: {path}

records.key: Converted crop metadata differs from the committed source rows; retain originals.
records.source: Converted crop metadata differs from the committed source rows; retain originals.
records.translation: Lýsigögn umbreyttra myndskurða eru frábrugðin staðfestum upprunafærslum; varðveittu frumritin.

records.key: Converted crop rows must use store locators instead of legacy PNG paths.
records.source: Converted crop rows must use store locators instead of legacy PNG paths.
records.translation: Færslur umbreyttra myndskurða verða að nota staðsetningarvísa gagnageymslunnar í stað eldri PNG-slóða.

records.key: Copied legacy crop metadata differs from the source database; retain originals.
records.source: Copied legacy crop metadata differs from the source database; retain originals.
records.translation: Afrituð eldri lýsigögn myndskurða eru frábrugðin upprunagagnagrunninum; varðveittu frumritin.

records.key: Copied project metadata failed verification: {path}
records.source: Copied project metadata failed verification: {path}
records.translation: Afrituð lýsigögn verkefnis stóðust ekki sannprófun: {path}

records.key: Crop PNG paths must stay inside the selected source project.
records.source: Crop PNG paths must stay inside the selected source project.
records.translation: PNG-slóðir myndskurða verða að vera innan valins upprunaverkefnis.

records.key: Crop PNGs have no measurements database; restore their original metadata before conversion.
records.source: Crop PNGs have no measurements database; restore their original metadata before conversion.
records.translation: PNG-myndir myndskurða hafa engan mælingagagnagrunn; endurheimtu upprunaleg lýsigögn þeirra fyrir umbreytingu.

records.key: Crop PNGs have no png_list metadata; restore the saved crop records before conversion.
records.source: Crop PNGs have no png_list metadata; restore the saved crop records before conversion.
records.translation: PNG-myndir myndskurða hafa engin png_list-lýsigögn; endurheimtu vistaðar færslur myndskurða fyrir umbreytingu.

records.key: Crop and object metadata disagree in {column}; resolve the saved annotation or relationship before conversion.
records.source: Crop and object metadata disagree in {column}; resolve the saved annotation or relationship before conversion.
records.translation: Lýsigögn myndskurðar og hlutar stemma ekki í {column}; leystu úr vistuðu merkingunni eða tengslunum fyrir umbreytingu.

records.key: Crop conversion supports untimed 2-D objects; unresolved identities, missing source masks and unsupported metadata remain blocked.
records.source: Crop conversion supports untimed 2-D objects; unresolved identities, missing source masks and unsupported metadata remain blocked.
records.translation: Umbreyting myndskurða styður 2-D hluti án tímavíddar; óleyst auðkenni, upprunagrímur sem vantar og óstudd lýsigögn stöðva áfram umbreytinguna.

records.key: Crop geometry differs from its source object; retain originals.
records.source: Crop geometry differs from its source object; retain originals.
records.translation: Rúmfræði myndskurðar er frábrugðin upprunahlutnum; varðveittu frumritin.

records.key: Crop identity aliases conflict; resolve the saved table keys before conversion.
records.source: Crop identity aliases conflict; resolve the saved table keys before conversion.
records.translation: Samheiti auðkennis myndskurðar stangast á; leystu úr vistuðum töflulyklum fyrir umbreytingu.

records.key: Crop index column {column} does not match its native scalar type; restore that column before conversion.
records.source: Crop index column {column} does not match its native scalar type; restore that column before conversion.
records.translation: Dálkurinn {column} í skrá myndskurða samsvarar ekki upprunalegri gerð stakgilda sinna; endurheimtu þann dálk fyrir umbreytingu.

records.key: Crop index columns differ from the native Measure schema; retain originals.
records.source: Crop index columns differ from the native Measure schema; retain originals.
records.translation: Dálkar skrár myndskurða eru frábrugðnir upprunalegu gagnaskema Measure; varðveittu frumritin.

records.key: Crop locator bounds do not match the source object; retain originals.
records.source: Crop locator bounds do not match the source object; retain originals.
records.translation: Mörk staðsetningarvísis myndskurðar samsvara ekki upprunahlutnum; varðveittu frumritin.

records.key: Crop masks must contain finite nonnegative integer labels; recover the original labelled mask.
records.source: Crop masks must contain finite nonnegative integer labels; recover the original labelled mask.
records.translation: Grímur myndskurða verða að innihalda endanleg heiltölumerki sem eru ekki neikvæð; endurheimtu upprunalegu merktu grímuna.

records.key: Crop metadata contains an unsupported scalar type; preserve the original database and resolve that column first.
records.source: Crop metadata contains an unsupported scalar type; preserve the original database and resolve that column first.
records.translation: Lýsigögn myndskurða innihalda óstudda gerð stakgilda; varðveittu upprunalega gagnagrunninn og leystu fyrst úr þeim dálki.

records.key: Crop metadata mixes scalar types within a column; preserve the source database and resolve that column before conversion.
records.source: Crop metadata mixes scalar types within a column; preserve the source database and resolve that column before conversion.
records.translation: Lýsigögn myndskurða blanda saman gerðum stakgilda innan dálks; varðveittu upprunagagnagrunninn og leystu úr þeim dálki fyrir umbreytingu.

records.key: Crop mode columns conflict; restore one documented object role per PNG row.
records.source: Crop mode columns conflict; restore one documented object role per PNG row.
records.translation: Dálkar myndskurðarhams stangast á; endurheimtu eitt skjalfest hlutverk hlutar fyrir hverja PNG-færslu.

records.key: Crop mode is ambiguous; record the original object role instead of choosing an overlapping object.
records.source: Crop mode is ambiguous; record the original object role instead of choosing an overlapping object.
records.translation: Myndskurðarhamurinn er tvíræður; skráðu upprunalegt hlutverk hlutarins í stað þess að velja hlut sem skarast við hann.

records.key: Crop object_id values are not unique; restore complete object identities before conversion.
records.source: Crop object_id values are not unique; restore complete object identities before conversion.
records.translation: object_id-gildi myndskurða eru ekki einkvæm; endurheimtu full auðkenni hluta fyrir umbreytingu.

records.key: Crop paths contain parent traversal; restore a direct path inside the source project.
records.source: Crop paths contain parent traversal; restore a direct path inside the source project.
records.translation: Slóðir myndskurða innihalda flakk í yfirliggjandi möppur; endurheimtu beina slóð innan upprunaverkefnisins.

records.key: Crop policy aliases conflict within a source row; restore the recorded margin and outside-pixel policy.
records.source: Crop policy aliases conflict within a source row; restore the recorded margin and outside-pixel policy.
records.translation: Samheiti myndskurðarreglna stangast á innan upprunafærslu; endurheimtu skráða spássíu og reglu um myndpunkta utan hlutarins.

records.key: Crop pool dtype or channel count changed after planning; retain originals.
records.source: Crop pool dtype or channel count changed after planning; retain originals.
records.translation: Gagnagerð eða rásafjöldi safns myndskurða breyttist eftir áætlanagerð; varðveittu frumritin.

records.key: Crop role is unsupported by the shared crop reader: {role}
records.source: Crop role is unsupported by the shared crop reader: {role}
records.translation: Sameiginlegi lesarinn fyrir myndskurði styður ekki hlutverk myndskurðarins: {role}

records.key: Crop row {row}: {problem}
records.source: Crop row {row}: {problem}
records.translation: Færsla myndskurðar {row}: {problem}

records.key: Crop rows need plate, row, column and field identities; restore the original acquisition keys.
records.source: Crop rows need plate, row, column and field identities; restore the original acquisition keys.
records.translation: Færslur myndskurða þurfa auðkenni plötu, raðar, dálks og sjónsviðs; endurheimtu upprunalega myndtökulykla.

records.key: Crop staging has no converter ownership record; choose a clean destination.
records.source: Crop staging has no converter ownership record; choose a clean destination.
records.translation: Undirbúningssvæði myndskurða hefur enga skráningu um eignarhald umbreytisins; veldu hreinan áfangastað.

records.key: Crop staging must be an ordinary converter-owned directory.
records.source: Crop staging must be an ordinary converter-owned directory.
records.translation: Undirbúningssvæði myndskurða verður að vera venjuleg mappa í eigu umbreytisins.

records.key: Deleting originals requires verification in the same invocation.
records.source: Deleting originals requires verification in the same invocation.
records.translation: Eyðing frumrita krefst sannprófunar í sama kalli.

records.key: Destination belongs to another conversion; choose a new directory.
records.source: Destination belongs to another conversion; choose a new directory.
records.translation: Áfangastaðurinn tilheyrir annarri umbreytingu; veldu nýja möppu.

records.key: Destination plan changed while waiting for the writer lock; inspect the existing conversion before retrying.
records.source: Destination plan changed while waiting for the writer lock; inspect the existing conversion before retrying.
records.translation: Áætlun áfangastaðarins breyttist á meðan beðið var eftir skriflásnum; skoðaðu fyrirliggjandi umbreytingu áður en þú reynir aftur.

records.key: Duplicate crop identities cannot be assigned one locator; resolve duplicate source rows first.
records.source: Duplicate crop identities cannot be assigned one locator; resolve duplicate source rows first.
records.translation: Ekki er hægt að úthluta einum staðsetningarvísi á tvítekin auðkenni myndskurða; leystu fyrst úr tvíteknum upprunafærslum.

records.key: Exported crop mask differs from the source object; retain originals.
records.source: Exported crop mask differs from the source object; retain originals.
records.translation: Útflutt gríma myndskurðar er frábrugðin upprunahlutnum; varðveittu frumritin.

records.key: Field names collide after well normalization: {path}
records.source: Field names collide after well normalization: {path}
records.translation: Heiti sjónsviða rekast á eftir stöðlun brunnaheita: {path}

records.key: Field numbers must be nonnegative: {name}
records.source: Field numbers must be nonnegative: {name}
records.translation: Númer sjónsviða mega ekki vera neikvæð: {name}

records.key: Image metadata verification failed: {field}
records.source: Image metadata verification failed: {field}
records.translation: Sannprófun lýsigagna myndar mistókst: {field}

records.key: Label metadata verification failed: {field}/{role}
records.source: Label metadata verification failed: {field}/{role}
records.translation: Sannprófun lýsigagna merkja mistókst: {field}/{role}

records.key: Legacy PNG rendering is verified separately; a raw_verified result retains PNGs that cannot be exported exactly.
records.source: Legacy PNG rendering is verified separately; a raw_verified result retains PNGs that cannot be exported exactly.
records.translation: Myndgerð eldri PNG-mynda er sannprófuð sérstaklega; niðurstaðan raw_verified varðveitir PNG-myndir sem ekki er hægt að flytja út nákvæmlega.

records.key: Legacy crop metadata already uses reserved crop-store columns; resolve those conflicting fields before conversion.
records.source: Legacy crop metadata already uses reserved crop-store columns; resolve those conflicting fields before conversion.
records.translation: Eldri lýsigögn myndskurða nota nú þegar frátekna dálka gagnageymslu myndskurða; leystu úr þeim árekstrum fyrir umbreytingu.

records.key: Legacy crop transforms could not be verified; keep the PNG files and originals.
records.source: Legacy crop transforms could not be verified; keep the PNG files and originals.
records.translation: Ekki tókst að sannprófa eldri ummyndanir myndskurða; varðveittu PNG-skrárnar og frumritin.

records.key: Mask shape does not match its field: {path}
records.source: Mask shape does not match its field: {path}
records.translation: Lögun grímu samsvarar ekki sjónsviði hennar: {path}

records.key: Measured masks appeared after planning; close the project and restart conversion.
records.source: Measured masks appeared after planning; close the project and restart conversion.
records.translation: Mælingagrímur komu fram eftir áætlanagerð; lokaðu verkefninu og endurræstu umbreytinguna.

records.key: Measured-mask provenance is stale; resolve it before conversion: {path}
records.source: Measured-mask provenance is stale; resolve it before conversion: {path}
records.translation: Upprunaskráning mælingagríma er úrelt; leystu úr því fyrir umbreytingu: {path}

records.key: Measurement rows may still need legacy crop sources; include and verify crops before deleting images or masks.
records.source: Measurement rows may still need legacy crop sources; include and verify crops before deleting images or masks.
records.translation: Mælingafærslur gætu enn þurft eldri upprunagögn myndskurða; taktu myndskurði með og sannprófaðu þá áður en myndum eða grímum er eytt.

records.key: Merged conversion needs .spacr_plane_layout.json; recover the saved channel layout first.
records.source: Merged conversion needs .spacr_plane_layout.json; recover the saved channel layout first.
records.translation: Umbreyting merged þarf .spacr_plane_layout.json; endurheimtu fyrst vistaða rásaskipan.

records.key: Merged conversion needs one NPY field and its plane layout: {path}
records.source: Merged conversion needs one NPY field and its plane layout: {path}
records.translation: Umbreyting merged þarf eitt NPY-sjónsvið og skipan myndplana þess: {path}

records.key: Merged shape does not match the saved plane layout: {path}
records.source: Merged shape does not match the saved plane layout: {path}
records.translation: Lögun gagna í merged samsvarar ekki vistaðri skipan myndplana: {path}

records.key: Mount the Windows project locally before conversion: {path}
records.source: Mount the Windows project locally before conversion: {path}
records.translation: Tengdu Windows-verkefnið við staðbundið skráakerfi fyrir umbreytingu: {path}

records.key: Multiple crop records reuse one PNG path; resolve the original crop identities.
records.source: Multiple crop records reuse one PNG path; resolve the original crop identities.
records.translation: Margar færslur myndskurða endurnýta sömu PNG-slóð; leystu úr upprunalegum auðkennum myndskurðanna.

records.key: Multiple mask files have the same field and role: {path}
records.source: Multiple mask files have the same field and role: {path}
records.translation: Margar grímuskrár hafa sama sjónsvið og hlutverk: {path}

records.key: Multiple merged fields share a crop identity; resolve the original field records.
records.source: Multiple merged fields share a crop identity; resolve the original field records.
records.translation: Mörg sameinuð sjónsvið í merged deila auðkenni myndskurðar; leystu úr upprunalegum sjónsviðsfærslum.

records.key: No selected legacy assets were found in this project.
records.source: No selected legacy assets were found in this project.
records.translation: Engin valin eldri gögn fundust í þessu verkefni.

records.key: OME-Zarr conversion requires the Zarr 3 dependency.
records.source: OME-Zarr conversion requires the Zarr 3 dependency.
records.translation: OME-Zarr-umbreyting krefst Zarr 3-hugbúnaðarpakkans.

records.key: One field contains different timepoints: {first} and {second}; retain originals until time-aware conversion is supported.
records.source: One field contains different timepoints: {first} and {second}; retain originals until time-aware conversion is supported.
records.translation: Eitt sjónsvið inniheldur ólíka tímapunkta: {first} og {second}; varðveittu frumritin þar til umbreyting með tímastuðningi er studd.

records.key: One raw crop exceeds the bounded conversion buffer; use a host with a suitable shared crop writer before conversion.
records.source: One raw crop exceeds the bounded conversion buffer; use a host with a suitable shared crop writer before conversion.
records.translation: Einn hrár myndskurður fer yfir mörk biðminnis umbreytingarinnar; notaðu tölvu með viðeigandi sameiginlegum skrifara fyrir myndskurði áður en umbreyting hefst.

records.key: Physical pixel size is unknown; unitless coordinates are used.
records.source: Physical pixel size is unknown; unitless coordinates are used.
records.translation: Raunstærð myndpunkta er óþekkt; einingarlaus hnit eru notuð.

records.key: Physical scale metadata verification failed: {field}
records.source: Physical scale metadata verification failed: {field}
records.translation: Sannprófun lýsigagna raunmælikvarða mistókst: {field}

records.key: Pixel verification failed for {name}; keep originals and inspect the destination.
records.source: Pixel verification failed for {name}; keep originals and inspect the destination.
records.translation: Sannprófun myndpunkta mistókst fyrir {name}; varðveittu frumritin og skoðaðu áfangastaðinn.

records.key: Plate or field names collide without case: {field}
records.source: Plate or field names collide without case: {field}
records.translation: Heiti platna eða sjónsviða rekast á þegar ekki er greint á milli há- og lágstafa: {field}

records.key: Raw crops use all native intensity channels and the recorded crop policy; only absent policies use margin 0 and zero_outside=False.
records.source: Raw crops use all native intensity channels and the recorded crop policy; only absent policies use margin 0 and zero_outside=False.
records.translation: Hráir myndskurðir nota allar upprunalegar styrkrásir og skráðar myndskurðarreglur; aðeins ef reglur vantar er notuð spássían 0 og zero_outside=False.

records.key: Reanchor the saved Windows crop paths to this local project before conversion.
records.source: Reanchor the saved Windows crop paths to this local project before conversion.
records.translation: Tengdu vistaðar Windows-slóðir myndskurða við þetta staðbundna verkefni fyrir umbreytingu.

records.key: Recorded crop margin must be a nonnegative integer; resolve the saved crop policy.
records.source: Recorded crop margin must be a nonnegative integer; resolve the saved crop policy.
records.translation: Skráð spássía myndskurða verður að vera heiltala sem er ekki neikvæð; leystu úr vistuðum myndskurðarreglum.

records.key: Recorded crop zero_outside must be true or false; resolve the saved crop policy.
records.source: Recorded crop zero_outside must be true or false; resolve the saved crop policy.
records.translation: Skráð zero_outside-gildi myndskurða verður að vera satt eða ósatt; leystu úr vistuðum myndskurðarreglum.

records.key: Rename this nonportable project component before conversion: {name}
records.source: Rename this nonportable project component before conversion: {name}
records.translation: Endurnefndu þennan hluta verkefnisins sem er ekki færanlegur milli kerfa fyrir umbreytingu: {name}

records.key: Resolve symlinks or case-insensitive path collisions before conversion: {path}
records.source: Resolve symlinks or case-insensitive path collisions before conversion: {path}
records.translation: Leystu úr tákntenglum eða slóðaárekstrum án aðgreiningar há- og lágstafa fyrir umbreytingu: {path}

records.key: Resume plan is incompatible; use the original inputs and options or a new destination.
records.source: Resume plan is incompatible; use the original inputs and options or a new destination.
records.translation: Áætlun um áframhald er ósamrýmanleg; notaðu upprunaleg inntök og valkosti eða nýjan áfangastað.

records.key: Saved channel names do not cover the merged channel selection: {field}
records.source: Saved channel names do not cover the merged channel selection: {field}
